shared_elements: low-relief carving worked into a weathered stone surface
a small figure with bent arms rendered in relief
incised linear grooves used as the main graphic device
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings in pale, weathered stone in which a small bent-armed figure and a plain disc appear, and both rely on broad incised grooves rather than modelled volume. But the compositions are fundamentally unrelated: A is a single centred medallion with lines radiating outward across a flat expanse, while B is an upright rectangular block organised into stacked horizontal registers of animals, birds and a banded frieze.
